text:
michelle: Quick design check-in — pushed a small iteration to the routing policies editor in the console. Main changes: preview/simulator tab, inline validation messages for rule conflicts, and a compact priority ordering UI. Can folks PTAL for UX/accessibility nits before I merge?

sam: scanning now. high level: love the simulator idea. A couple of quick asks: 1) make the drag handle larger (10px target) for mobile, 2) show a subtle highlight for the currently selected rule (not just bold), 3) move priority number to the left of the rule so it reads like a list.

alex: re: validation - backend will still run a full check but we should mirror key checks client-side to avoid surprise failures on save. suggest messages: "Conflict: rule A and B overlap on path /chat with overlapping model constraints" and "Invalid weight: sum of fallbacks must be 100%". We can reuse the existing /validate endpoint.

sam: agreed on copy. also, microcopy tweak for the simulator CTA: "Run preview with sample traffic" -> shorter: "Simulate samples". and add an info tooltip explaining that simulator uses synthetic requests (not live traffic).

jordan: accessibility nits: keyboard ordering currently focuses into the rule card then trap for nested controls. Need linear tab order: priority -> condition inputs -> action selector -> simulate button. Also add aria-live on the validation banner so screen readers announce errors on save.

michelle: good call. For the priority UI I prototyped two variants — stacked numbers vs inline badge. I think inline badge keeps vertical rhythm. Attached screenshots in the PR.

sam: inline badge looks cleaner but make sure color contrast meets 4.5:1 for the badge text. On hover state we currently only change shadow; add a visible outline for keyboard focus.

alex: small engineering constraint: simulation runs query against a sandboxed policy engine that can evaluate multiple routes. We can return a decisions array. Proposed preview payload (for the simulator result):

```
{
  "input": "{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}",
  "decisions": [
    {"rule":"rule-3","action":"route","model":"gpt-open-8b","fallback":"redwood-small","reason":"priority match"}
  ],
  "warnings":["overlapping conditions detected between rule-2 and rule-3"]
}
```

alex: please ensure UI surfaces `warnings` clearly and links the warning to the affected rules (clickable highlight).

sam: about validation messages — prefer short titles then details. e.g. Title: "Overlap detected" Detail: "Rule 2 and Rule 3 both match requests to /chat when header X=beta. Click to highlight". Avoid long single-line error banners.

jordan: also ensure color isn't the only signal — include an icon and text label for severity (error/warning/info). For keyboard users, provide a "Focus next issue" shortcut inside the validation pane.

michelle: 👍 good list. One more UX question: when user drags a rule and creates a reordering, do we immediately apply or show an "Apply changes" CTA? My leaning: optimistic local reorder preview + explicit "Save changes" to avoid accidental flips. Thoughts?

sam: keep explicit "Save changes". show a small toast: "Draft changes — save to apply routing order" with undo.

alex: explicit save is safer for us too. also avoids server churn. backend will accept ordering payload like: `["rule-3","rule-1","rule-2"]`. validation on save will run and return conflicts w/ HTTP 409 and details.

ui-review-bot: Automated accessibility check: focusable elements detected: 23. Contrast issues: badge background #4A90E2 vs text #FFFFFF passes. Keyboard order potential issue at rule-card-5. (See CI link: https://ci.internal/ui/a11y/1759001234)

michelle: thanks @ui-review-bot. I'll fix the tab order on rule-card-5 today. Plan: implement inline badge, bigger drag handles, aria-live on validation banner, simulator tooltip, and explicit save with toast + undo. I'll push a follow-up PR with updated copy and screenshots.

sam: ping me when ready, I'll run a quick heuristic review. :eyes:

alex: will add the client-side validation rules and wire the simulator endpoint to the UI.

michelle: end state for the PR: accessible keyboard nav, clear validation messaging + links to rules, simulator that shows decisions/warnings, explicit "Save changes". Thanks all! :rocket:
